sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$300.
Paid balancing starts Mon 6:30pm CT: worst line to -$150 by Mon 7:05pm CT, up to $100.
At Mon 6:45pm CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Mon 7:15pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
